assertion.statement: In Crossplane v2.0.0 the earlier change to the run function protobuf's extra resources field name was rolled back, so the extra resources field in the RunFunction protobuf keeps its prior name.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The single release-note line names only the rollback itself; it does not state which environments are affected (e.g. whether the rolled-back name was ever released outside 2.0.0 prereleases, or which function builds/SDKs used the renamed field), so no exposure condition can be asserted.; consequence: The evidence does not state what happens (or fails) in an environment after the rollback — it neither names the old/new field names nor describes any breakage, rejection, or required operator step.
